title: Effects of Pain on Driving Performance and Cognition.
brief_summary: It has been suggested that cognitive functioning is impaired in chronic pain patients. Since most of these pain patients engage in daily activities including driving, it was hypothezised that they may have an increased risk of becoming involved in traffic accidents.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

age driving licence driving experience normal vision right-handed fluently Dutch speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

psychological or physical disorder drug or alcohol abuse psychotropic medication use excessive smoking, drinking
